title: Clamp a natural number to an interval
specification:
def Spec (f : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ lo hi x, lo ≤ hi →
    lo ≤ f lo hi x ∧ f lo hi x ≤ hi ∧
    (lo ≤ x → x ≤ hi → f lo hi x = x) ∧
    (x < lo → f lo hi x = lo) ∧
    (hi < x → f lo hi x = hi)
constraints: Use only the supplied Std import.
Return an expression body and a proof term; do not add global declarations.
Use comparisons and branches rather than a library clamp.
